land.title: Get paid every week to post on TikTok
land.sub: We prepare the slideshows. You post them from your phone, about 20 minutes a day. You get paid every Monday.
anim.7: Paste the link in your dashboard
pay.title: Weekly pay
pay.note: Paid every Monday through Ruul, for the posts of the week before.
cond.title: Conditions
cond.2: Two phones: one is used only for this work
cond.3: You live in one of the open countries — no VPN
cond.4: About 20 minutes a day, every day
cond.5: You work as an independent freelancer
form.title: Apply
q.pays_actuel: Which country are you in right now?
q.heures: How much time can you give every day?
q.tiktok: Do you already use TikTok? How?
q.contenu: What kind of content do you enjoy?
form.consent: I agree to be contacted about my application and my work by WhatsApp, SMS and email
codes.title: Verify your email and WhatsApp
codes.sub: We sent a 6-digit code to {email} and to {whatsapp}.
codes.expired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
codes.tooMany: Too many tries. Ask for a new code.
dec.wait: We'll get back to you within 48h
dec.ok: Last step: read and sign your freelance agreement.
ctr.title: Your freelance agreement
ctr.englishOnly: The agreement is in English. This is the version you sign.
ctr.note: By clicking “I sign”, you sign this agreement electronically. We keep the date, your IP address and your device as proof.
dash.title: Your setup
dash.slip: Finish the warm-up before Sunday 23:59, or your first post moves one week later.
step.tiktok.title: Create your TikTok account
step.tiktok.body: Create a new TikTok account on your work phone with this username:
step.tiktok.notFound: We can't find @{handle}. Type the username you really created:
step.tiktok.unreadable: TikTok didn't answer. Try again in a minute.
step.profil.title: Set up your profile
step.profil.body: Copy these into your TikTok profile:
step.profil.name: Name
step.warmup.title: Warm up the account
step.warmup.body: For a few days, scroll, like and follow accounts about learning and self-improvement, about 20 minutes a day. Don't post yet.
step.slack.title: Join our Slack
step.slack.body: Ask questions and meet the other creators.
step.ruul.title: Set up Ruul to get paid on Monday
step.ruul.body: Ruul pays you for your first week of posts. It takes 5 minutes.
login.title: Log in
login.sub: We'll send a code to the email you applied with.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
